name: PlayerDB
tagline: Cross-game player ID lookup for Minecraft, Steam, Xbox, and more
description: PlayerDB is a free public API that resolves player usernames and IDs across multiple gaming platforms including Minecraft, Steam, Xbox Live, and others. Developers use it to look up profile data, convert between username and UUID/ID formats, and fetch platform-specific player metadata from a single endpoint family without managing multiple platform APIs.

auth.details: No authentication required; public endpoints accept unauthenticated GET requests

rate_limits: Very generous non-numeric limits; HTTP 429 responses include a Retry-After header. Higher-volume users may contact the maintainer.
use_cases: resolve a Minecraft username to UUID
look up a Steam profile by vanity URL or SteamID
fetch cross-platform player avatar and profile metadata
validate whether a game username exists on a platform
